content: {"like": ["Video quality rated 4/5 with deeply saturated colors that are not over‑popped, natural skin tones, and clear detail even in dark scenes.", "No artifacting observed despite the film being shot in video.", "CGI scenes, while not perfect, were generally well‑done and the CGI of Tarzan and natives running along tree branches was dizzying but not overly obvious.", "Audio levels were properly set, making quiet dialogue clean and discernible, and the 7.1 surround provided an immersive ambient experience.", "Good documentation extras on CGI effects, actor training, and story development."], "dislike": ["CGI apes were noticeably less natural than those in recent Planet of the Apes films and could be seen clearly, indicating less than perfect CGI.", "Some CGI was less than perfect overall, especially the CGI of the apes.", "Compression was increased due to several ads for other films listed as extras, reducing the average bitrate to the mid‑30s Mbps.", "Audio editors did not fully utilize the 7.1 codec, resulting in limited discreet directionality from front, side, or rear channels and a lack of effort in the 7.1 mix, likely due to budget constraints."]}
